description: Serving launch posted in the Local Inference Lab Discord by rajamourgou

metadata.observed_command: set -euo pipefail export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.2/bin:$PATH export PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True,max_split_size_mb:512 export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 export NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=5 export NCCL_ALGO=Ring export VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM=0 export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN export VLLM_TORCH_COMPILE_LEVEL=plus export VLLM_SLEEP_WHEN_IDLE=1 export SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1 export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 MODEL="lukealonso/MiniMax-M2.7-NVFP4" MODELNAME="MiniMax-M2.7" GPU_UTIL=0.97 SAMPLER_OVERRIDE="{\"temperature\": 1, \"top_p\": 0.95, \"top_k\": 40, \"repetition_penalty\": 1.1, \"frequency_penalty\": 0.40}" MAX_MODEL_LEN="${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-191000}" MAX_NUM_SEQS="${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-64}" MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS="${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-65536}" ENABLE_CHUNKED_PREFILL="${ENABLE_CHUNKED_PREFILL:-1}" KV_CACHE_DTYPE="${KV_CACHE_DTYPE:-fp8}" vllm serve "${MODEL}" --served-model-name "${MODELNAME}" --trust-remote-code --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_UTIL} --tensor-parallel-size 2 --disable-custom-all-reduce --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser minimax_m2 --reasoning-parser minimax_m2 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8013 --kv-cache-dtype "${KV_CACHE_DTYPE}" --enable-chunked-prefill --enable-prefix-caching --max-model-len "${MAX_MODEL_LEN}" --max-num-seqs "${MAX_NUM_SEQS}" --max-num-batched-tokens "${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS}" --override-generation-config "${SAMPLER_OVERRIDE}"
